page.layout: One page of running text, with a marginal note in the left margin beside the middle lines. Running head at top centre, page number top left. Catchword at the foot right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: ad Amnicam portam, unde procedit, nomen invenit. Caeterae duae portae plateas excipiunt etiam suas, sed per angulum à reliquis derivatas, quarum portarum altera à grue machina (Kraenpoorte[?]) altera ab attollendis lapidibus, ut vulgus arbitratur; ut autem veritas habet, à ponticulo lapideo, qui quondam isto in latere civitatis fuit, quem Germani Stetgentil[?] dicunt, (Stelgentilpoorte[?]) nomen ferunt. Plateae in urbe erant, cùm hæc primùm ederem, majores ad xxv I,[?] minores vii, præter angiportus aliquot. Majoribus accessit proximis his annis vicesima septima prorsus nova, ædificijs elegans, à fori majoris angulo, qui occidentem & boream intuetur, per medium hortum cœnobii Franciscani ducta, mittens in regionem, quæ ad amnem porrigiturVrbis incrementa., ex ipsâ re nova nominata. Minorum quoque numerus crevit. Antiquitus cùm minor esset civitatis fortuna, ut omnia solent à parvis principiis oriri, pro mœnibus usa est septo ligneo è trabibus contexto. Deinde ante annos plùs minùs cccc. I muro lateritio firmo cum fossâ

page.notes: Running head and page number as printed. Blackletter words (Kraenpoorte, Stetgentil, Stelgentilpoorte) are hard to read on the scan and are marked [?]. "xxv I" is printed in a form I could not settle; kept as printed with [?]. "fepto" in the print is read as septo. The margin note "Vrbis incrementa." is printed in italics, split over two lines with a hyphen after "in-". The catchword "fossâ" is printed with a long s, transcribed as plain s. The faint watermark in the bottom right corner is a digitiser's mark and is left out.
